rationale: The assistant correctly identified 22E as a fridge evaporator-fan fault, used the customer's 9C reading, weak airflow and vent frost to make ice build-up the 'leading possibility', and recommended a safe unplugged 24-48h manual defrost with no sharp tools or hairdryers, exactly matching the ground truth. Escalation to Samsung service via the warranty route if the code recurs was correct and no parts were pushed. Minor weaknesses: the first reply opens with a garbled numbered list lacking any framing, and the 22E explanation and defrost warnings are re-stated in nearly every message, with the settings/door-switch checks repeated across turns (though the customer had not yet done them).
